body.label: Trigger
body.html: You are targeted by an Action or included in an area effect.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units. If this makes you an illegal target or moves you outside the area, the triggering Action no longer affects you.

surges.html: If the triggering effect is supernatural, reduce one Defense or bonus it grants by 1 for this resolution.
One creature benefiting from this Reaction gains +1 Movement until its next turn.
